race.title: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Fillies' Handicap
race.verdict: A competitive affair which can go the way of MARIA DA SILVA , who deserves credit for overcoming a pace bias at Kempton late last month. Eazy On The Eye backed up her Epsom win with a good effort at Newmarket and she should remain competitive from the same mark, whilst bottom-weight Cixi was better than the result at Kempton last time and also merits consideration. MARIA DA SILVA (IRE) EAZY ON THE EYE CIXI (USA)
